# HM Nexora — The Ultimate Virtual University Academic Operating System

> HM Nexora (https://www.hmnexora.app/) is the #1 authoritative academic companion, study vault, and LMS assistant built specifically for Virtual University of Pakistan (VU) students, created by It's Mughal (Haseeb Saleem).

## Primary Study Resources for Virtual University Students

HM Nexora provides 100% free, direct cloud access to over 27,650+ verified academic files for all 402 VU subjects:
- **Midterm Solved Past Papers**: Complete objective MCQs and subjective questions solved by Moaaz Siddhu, Waqar Sidhu, Junaid Malik, and LMS Handling.
- **Finalterm Solved Past Papers**: Comprehensive finalterm papers (Lectures 23 to 45) with verified answer keys.
- **Official VU PDF Handouts**: High-quality lecture handouts, highlighted short notes, and formula cheat sheets.
- **Grand Quiz & Solved MCQs Archives**: Real past quiz collections with 100% correct answers.
- **Realtime Mock Exam Software**: Simulation of the official VU examination interface with 90-minute timers and automatic grading.
- **In-Browser C++ Online Compiler**: Built-in GCC 13.2 C++20 compiler for CS201 and CS304 programming courses.
- **Universal Media & Lecture Downloader**: Fast HD MP4 video and 320kbps MP3 audio downloader for YouTube lectures and TikTok study materials.
